scenario: A marine-permit agency compares two application workflows across commercial ports, fishing harbors, and remote island offices. Officials prefer Workflow A because its aggregate approval-completion rate is much higher.

data.description: Completion rate by office type and workflow.

question: (a) Which workflow performs better in each office type? (b) If the agency's long-run mix is 35% commercial ports, 40% fishing harbors, and 25% remote island offices, compute the corrected completion rate for each workflow. (c) Which workflow should be recommended?

ground_truth.explanation: Workflow B is stronger in every office type; Workflow A only looks better in the aggregate because it handled more easy commercial-port cases.

naive_answer: Workflow A should be recommended because its aggregate completion rate is higher.
naive_trap: Workflow mix differs sharply by office type.
